###### plot results
```{r}
# --- Step 5: Faceted volcano plots — one per pairwise comparison, faceted by Trait ---
# Thermoproteota = Nitrososphaerota in this taxonomy file; add to color palette
phylum_colors["Thermoproteota"] <- "#9457eb"

# Special highlight colors — override Phylum color for taxa of interest
special_colors <- c(
  "Xanthomonadales"     = "#E63946",  # red
  "Steroidobacteraceae" = "#FF6A00",  # neon orange
  "Chitinophagaceae"    = "#2A9D8F",   # teal
  "Edaphobacter" = "hotpink"
)
all_colors <- c(phylum_colors, special_colors)

# Toggle: show best-taxonomy labels on special-highlighted taxa (Xanthomonadales, etc.)
label_special      <- T
# Toggle: label ALL points in Step 5 (per-comparison, faceted by trait)
label_all          <- F
# Toggle: label ALL points in Step 5b (per-trait, faceted by comparison) — independent
label_all_traits   <- F


for (comp in unique(all_mag_results$Comparison)) {
  comp_data <- all_mag_results %>%
    filter(Comparison == comp) %>%
    left_join(taxonomy, by = c("MAG" = "Genome")) %>%
    mutate(
      Phylum         = ifelse(is.na(Phylum), "Unknown", Phylum),
      neg_log10_padj = -log10(wilcox_padj),
      is_sig         = wilcox_padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FC) >= 1,
      # Phylum by default; specific taxa override (most specific first)
      color_group = case_when(
        !is.na(Family) & Family == "Steroidobacteraceae"                     ~ "Steroidobacteraceae",
        !is.na(Family) & Family == "Chitinophagaceae"                        ~ "Chitinophagaceae",
        !is.na(Order)  & Order  == "Xanthomonadales"                         ~ "Xanthomonadales",
        !is.na(Genus) & Genus == "Edaphobacter" ~ "Edaphobacter",
        TRUE ~ Phylum
      )
    )

  plot_data <- comp_data %>% filter(is_sig)
  if (nrow(plot_data) < 2) next

  g1 <- unique(comp_data$group1)
  g2 <- unique(comp_data$group2)

  # Dunn diff + padj annotation — top-left corner of each Trait facet
  # Uses x = -Inf / y = Inf anchoring (independent of axis scale)
  dunn_labels <- dunn_sig %>%
    filter(Comparison == comp, Trait %in% unique(plot_data$Trait)) %>%
    select(Trait, Mean_diff, p_adj) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0("Dunn diff=", signif(Mean_diff, 3),
                          "\nDunn padj=",  signif(p_adj, 2)))

  # Subset for optional labels: shorten MAG names to the last segment
  special_pts <- plot_data %>%
    filter(color_group %in% names(special_colors)) %>%
    mutate(short_label = case_when(
      !is.na(Species) & Species != "" ~ Species,
      !is.na(Genus)   & Genus   != "" ~ Genus,
      !is.na(Family)  & Family  != "" ~ Family,
      !is.na(Order)   & Order   != "" ~ Order,
      !is.na(Class)   & Class   != "" ~ Class,
      !is.na(Phylum)  & Phylum  != "" ~ Phylum,
      TRUE ~ MAG
    ))

  n_traits <- length(unique(plot_data$Trait))
  ncols    <- min(3, n_traits)
  n_rows   <- ceiling(n_traits / ncols)

  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = log2FC, y = neg_log10_padj)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "solid",
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(color = color_group), size = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_text(data      = dunn_labels,
              aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE,
              hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.2,
              size = 2.2, color = "grey30", lineheight = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(values = all_colors, name = "Taxon",
                       na.value = "grey70") +
    facet_wrap(~ Trait, scales = "free_y", ncol = ncols,
               labeller = labeller(Trait = function(x)
                 stringr::str_wrap(gsub("\\.", " ", x), width = 25))) +
    labs(
      title    = paste(g1, "vs", g2),
      subtitle = "Wilcoxon padj < 0.05 & |log2FC| \u2265 1  |  positive log2FC = higher in left group",
      x        = paste0("log2FC  (positive = ", g1, "  |  negative = ", g2, ")"),
      y        = "-log10(padj)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      strip.text      = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid      = element_blank()
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

  # Labels: special taxa only, or all points (label_all overrides label_special)
  label_data <- if (label_all) {
    plot_data %>% mutate(best_label = case_when(
      !is.na(Species) & Species != "" ~ Species,
      !is.na(Genus)   & Genus   != "" ~ Genus,
      !is.na(Family)  & Family  != "" ~ Family,
      !is.na(Order)   & Order   != "" ~ Order,
      !is.na(Class)   & Class   != "" ~ Class,
      !is.na(Phylum)  & Phylum  != "" ~ Phylum,
      TRUE ~ MAG
    ))
  } else if (label_special) {
    special_pts %>% rename(best_label = short_label)
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  if (!is.null(label_data) && nrow(label_data) > 0) {
    p <- p + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data          = label_data,
      aes(x = log2FC, y = neg_log10_padj, label = best_label),
      inherit.aes   = FALSE,
      size          = 2.0,
      max.overlaps  = Inf,
      segment.size  = 0.2,
      segment.color = "grey50"
    )
  }

  fname <- file.path(out_dir,
    paste0("volcano_MAG_facet_", gsub(" - ", "_vs_", comp), "_GRAN3.svg"))
  ggsave(fname, plot = p, device = svglite::svglite,
         width  = min(24, ncols * 2.5),
         height = max(7, n_rows * 2),
         bg = "white")
  cat("Saved:", basename(fname), "\n")
}

# --- Step 5b: Transposed — one plot per significant Trait, faceted by pairwise comparison ---
sig_traits_plot <- unique(all_mag_results$Trait[
  all_mag_results$wilcox_padj < 0.05 & abs(all_mag_results$log2FC) >= 1
])

for (tr in sig_traits_plot) {
  trait_data <- all_mag_results %>%
    filter(Trait == tr) %>%
    left_join(taxonomy, by = c("MAG" = "Genome")) %>%
    mutate(
      Phylum         = ifelse(is.na(Phylum), "Unknown", Phylum),
      neg_log10_padj = -log10(wilcox_padj),
      is_sig         = wilcox_padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FC) >= 1,
      color_group = case_when(
        !is.na(Family) & Family == "Steroidobacteraceae" ~ "Steroidobacteraceae",
        !is.na(Family) & Family == "Chitinophagaceae"    ~ "Chitinophagaceae",
        !is.na(Order)  & Order  == "Xanthomonadales"     ~ "Xanthomonadales",
        !is.na(Genus) & Genus == "Edaphobacter" ~ "Edaphobacter",
        TRUE ~ Phylum
      )
    )

  plot_data <- trait_data %>% filter(is_sig)
  if (nrow(plot_data) < 2) next

  # Dunn stats per Comparison facet — top-left corner
  dunn_labels_tr <- dunn_sig %>%
    filter(Trait == tr, Comparison %in% unique(plot_data$Comparison)) %>%
    select(Comparison, Mean_diff, p_adj, enriched) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0("Dunn diff=",   signif(Mean_diff, 3),
                          "\nDunn padj=", signif(p_adj, 2),
                          "\nEnriched: ", enriched))

  special_pts_tr <- plot_data %>%
    filter(color_group %in% names(special_colors)) %>%
    mutate(short_label = case_when(
      !is.na(Species) & Species != "" ~ Species,
      !is.na(Genus)   & Genus   != "" ~ Genus,
      !is.na(Family)  & Family  != "" ~ Family,
      !is.na(Order)   & Order   != "" ~ Order,
      !is.na(Class)   & Class   != "" ~ Class,
      !is.na(Phylum)  & Phylum  != "" ~ Phylum,
      TRUE ~ MAG
    ))

  n_comps  <- length(unique(plot_data$Comparison))
  tr_title <- stringr::str_wrap(gsub("\\.", " ", tr), width = 60)

  p2 <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = log2FC, y = neg_log10_padj)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed",
               color = "grey60", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "solid",
               color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_point(aes(color = color_group), size = 2, alpha = 0.85) +
    geom_text(data      = dunn_labels_tr,
              aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE,
              hjust = -0.05, vjust = 1.2,
              size = 2.2, color = "grey30", lineheight = 0.9) +
    scale_color_manual(values = all_colors, name = "Taxon",
                       na.value = "grey70") +
    facet_wrap(~ Comparison, scales = "free_y", ncol = min(3, n_comps)) +
    labs(
      title    = tr_title,
      subtitle = "Wilcoxon padj < 0.05 & |log2FC| \u2265 1  |  positive log2FC = higher in left group",
      x        = "log2FC",
      y        = "-log10(padj)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(size = 9, lineheight = 1.3),
      strip.text      = element_text(size = 7, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid      = element_blank()
    ) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off")

  label_data_tr <- if (label_all_traits) {
    plot_data %>% mutate(best_label = case_when(
      !is.na(Species) & Species != "" ~ Species,
      !is.na(Genus)   & Genus   != "" ~ Genus,
      !is.na(Family)  & Family  != "" ~ Family,
      !is.na(Order)   & Order   != "" ~ Order,
      !is.na(Class)   & Class   != "" ~ Class,
      !is.na(Phylum)  & Phylum  != "" ~ Phylum,
      TRUE ~ MAG
    ))
  } else if (label_special) {
    special_pts_tr %>% rename(best_label = short_label)
  } else {
    NULL
  }

  if (!is.null(label_data_tr) && nrow(label_data_tr) > 0) {
    p2 <- p2 + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data          = label_data_tr,
      aes(x = log2FC, y = neg_log10_padj, label = best_label),
      inherit.aes   = FALSE,
      size          = 2.0,
      max.overlaps  = Inf,
      segment.size  = 0.2,
      segment.color = "grey50"
    )
  }

  safe_trait <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", tr)
  fname2 <- file.path(out_dir,
    paste0("volcano_trait_", safe_trait, "_GRAN3.svg"))
  ggsave(fname2, plot = p2, device = svglite::svglite,
         width  = min(18, n_comps * 4.5),
         height = 7.5,
         bg = "white")
  cat("Saved:", basename(fname2), "\n")
}
```

##### Vitamin B transport — HMM-level weighted Wilcoxon (GRAN3)
```{r vitb_hmm_wilcox_gran3}
# ── Step 1: Define vitamin B transport HMMs ────────────────────────────────
vitb_trait <- "Resource.Acquisition.Substrate.uptake.vitamin.transport.vitamin.B.transport"

vitb_hmm_map <- list(
  Biotin       = c("bioY", "ecfT", "ecfA1", "ecfA2"),
  Riboflavin   = c("ecfA1", "ribS", "ribP", "sam"),
  Pantothenate = c("panF"),
  Thiamine     = c("thiB", "thiP", "thiQ", "thiT"),
  Vitamin_B    = c("ydjE", "niaX"),
  Vitamin_B12  = c("btuB", "btuC", "btuD", "btuF")
)

vitb_hmms_all <- unique(unlist(vitb_hmm_map))
vitb_hmms     <- vitb_hmms_all[vitb_hmms_all %in% colnames(bin_hmms)]
cat("HMMs found in bin_hmms:", paste(vitb_hmms, collapse = ", "), "\n")
cat("HMMs missing:", paste(base::setdiff(vitb_hmms_all, vitb_hmms), collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Lookup table: HMM → vitamin category (first match wins for shared HMMs)
hmm_to_vitamin <- purrr::imap_dfr(vitb_hmm_map, function(hmms, vit) {
  tibble::tibble(HMM = base::intersect(hmms, vitb_hmms), Vitamin = vit)
}) %>% distinct(HMM, .keep_all = TRUE)

# ── Step 2: Subset vitamin B MAGs ─────────────────────────────────────────
vitb_mags <- sig_results_hmms %>%
  filter(Trait == vitb_trait) %>%
  distinct(MAG) %>%
  pull(MAG)
cat("Vitamin B MAGs:", length(vitb_mags), "\n")

# ── Step 3: Aligned coverage and HMM matrices ─────────────────────────────
hmm_vals <- bin_hmms %>%
  filter(Genome %in% vitb_mags) %>%
  select(Genome, all_of(vitb_hmms)) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames("Genome")

common_mags <- base::intersect(rownames(meancoverage_norm), rownames(hmm_vals))
cat("Vitamin B MAGs with coverage:", length(common_mags), "\n")

cov_sub <- meancoverage_norm[common_mags, cov_sample_cols, drop = FALSE]  # MAG × sample
hmm_sub <- hmm_vals[common_mags, , drop = FALSE]                          # MAG × HMM

# ── Step 4: Weighted sum + normalize by mapped reads ──────────────────────
# weighted[sample, HMM] = sum over MAGs of (norm_cov × hmm_val)
# meancoverage_norm already = (Trimmed Mean / fastq-total) × 1e12
# Divide by Mapped.Reads to account for unequal mapping (matches line-6413 method)
weighted_mat <- t(as.matrix(cov_sub)) %*% as.matrix(hmm_sub)  # sample × HMM

bam_stats_vb <- read.csv(
  "/Users/ptasoff/My Drive/Preston_Projects/Vegtype/Analysis/Microtrait/coverm_genome/bam_stats_updated_Nov2024.csv"
) %>% select(sample, Mapped.Reads)

weighted_df <- as.data.frame(weighted_mat) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
  left_join(bam_stats_vb, by = "sample") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(vitb_hmms), ~ . / Mapped.Reads)) %>%
  select(-Mapped.Reads) %>%
  mutate(Vegtype = sample_vegtype[sample]) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Vegtype))

cat("Samples in weighted_df:", nrow(weighted_df), "\n")

# ── Step 5: Pairwise Wilcoxon for each HMM ────────────────────────────────
vegtypes <- sort(unique(weighted_df$Vegtype))
pairs    <- combn(vegtypes, 2, simplify = FALSE)

wilcox_res <- purrr::map_df(pairs, function(pr) {
  g1 <- pr[1]; g2 <- pr[2]
  d1 <- weighted_df %>% filter(Vegtype == g1)
  d2 <- weighted_df %>% filter(Vegtype == g2)

  res <- purrr::map_df(vitb_hmms, function(hmm) {
    v1 <- d1[[hmm]]; v2 <- d2[[hmm]]
    if (length(na.omit(c(v1, v2))) < 4 || length(unique(c(v1, v2))) <= 1) return(NULL)
    wt <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(v1, v2, exact = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(wt)) return(NULL)
    m1 <- mean(v1, na.rm = TRUE); m2 <- mean(v2, na.rm = TRUE)
    tibble::tibble(
      HMM      = hmm,
      group1   = g1,
      group2   = g2,
      mean_g1  = m1,
      mean_g2  = m2,
      log2FC   = log2((m1 + 1e-20) / (m2 + 1e-20)),
      wilcox_p = wt$p.value
    )
  })

  if (is.null(res) || nrow(res) == 0) return(NULL)
  res %>% mutate(wilcox_padj = p.adjust(wilcox_p, method = "BH"))
}) %>%
  left_join(hmm_to_vitamin, by = "HMM") %>%
  mutate(
    direction  = ifelse(log2FC > 0, group1, group2),
    Comparison = paste(group1, "-", group2)
  ) %>%
  select(Vitamin, HMM, Comparison, group1, group2, direction,
         mean_g1, mean_g2, log2FC, wilcox_p, wilcox_padj) %>%
  arrange(Vitamin, HMM, Comparison)

cat("Total Wilcoxon rows:", nrow(wilcox_res),
    "| Significant (padj<0.05):", sum(wilcox_res$wilcox_padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# ── Step 6: Save ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
write.csv(wilcox_res,
          file.path(out_dir, "vitB_hmm_wilcox_GRAN3.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: vitB_hmm_wilcox_GRAN3.csv\n")
```

##### All-trait HMM-level weighted Wilcoxon (GRAN3)
```{r all_trait_hmm_wilcox_gran3}
# Loops over every significant trait in sig_results_hmms.
# For each trait: subset enriched MAGs → compute weighted HMM community values
# → pairwise Wilcoxon across vegtypes → save full + significant-only tables.

bam_stats_at <- read.csv(
  "/Users/ptasoff/My Drive/Preston_Projects/Vegtype/Analysis/Microtrait/coverm_genome/bam_stats_updated_Nov2024.csv"
) %>% select(sample, Mapped.Reads)

all_hmm_cols <- base::setdiff(colnames(bin_hmms), "Genome")
all_traits_list <- unique(sig_results_hmms$Trait)
cat("Traits to process:", length(all_traits_list), "\n")

run_hmm_wilcox_for_trait <- function(trait_name) {
  trait_mags <- sig_results_hmms %>%
    filter(Trait == trait_name) %>%
    distinct(MAG) %>%
    pull(MAG)
  if (length(trait_mags) < 2) return(NULL)

  hmm_mat <- bin_hmms %>%
    filter(Genome %in% trait_mags) %>%
    select(Genome, all_of(all_hmm_cols)) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("Genome")

  # Keep only HMMs with at least one hit in these MAGs
  hmm_present <- all_hmm_cols[colSums(hmm_mat) > 0]
  if (length(hmm_present) == 0) return(NULL)
  hmm_mat <- hmm_mat[, hmm_present, drop = FALSE]

  common_mags <- base::intersect(rownames(meancoverage_norm), rownames(hmm_mat))
  if (length(common_mags) < 2) return(NULL)

  cov_sub <- meancoverage_norm[common_mags, cov_sample_cols, drop = FALSE]
  hmm_sub <- hmm_mat[common_mags, , drop = FALSE]

  weighted_mat <- t(as.matrix(cov_sub)) %*% as.matrix(hmm_sub)  # sample × HMM

  weighted_df <- as.data.frame(weighted_mat) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("sample") %>%
    left_join(bam_stats_at, by = "sample") %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(hmm_present), ~ . / Mapped.Reads)) %>%
    select(-Mapped.Reads) %>%
    mutate(Vegtype = sample_vegtype[sample]) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Vegtype))

  vegtypes <- sort(unique(weighted_df$Vegtype))
  if (length(vegtypes) < 2) return(NULL)
  pairs <- combn(vegtypes, 2, simplify = FALSE)

  purrr::map_df(pairs, function(pr) {
    g1 <- pr[1]; g2 <- pr[2]
    d1 <- weighted_df %>% filter(Vegtype == g1)
    d2 <- weighted_df %>% filter(Vegtype == g2)

    res <- purrr::map_df(hmm_present, function(hmm) {
      v1 <- d1[[hmm]]; v2 <- d2[[hmm]]
      if (length(na.omit(c(v1, v2))) < 4 || length(unique(c(v1, v2))) <= 1) return(NULL)
      wt <- tryCatch(wilcox.test(v1, v2, exact = FALSE), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(wt)) return(NULL)
      m1 <- mean(v1, na.rm = TRUE); m2 <- mean(v2, na.rm = TRUE)
      tibble::tibble(
        HMM      = hmm,
        group1   = g1,
        group2   = g2,
        mean_g1  = m1,
        mean_g2  = m2,
        log2FC   = log2((m1 + 1e-20) / (m2 + 1e-20)),
        wilcox_p = wt$p.value
      )
    })
    if (is.null(res) || nrow(res) == 0) return(NULL)
    res %>% mutate(wilcox_padj = p.adjust(wilcox_p, method = "BH"))
  }) %>%
    mutate(Trait = trait_name)
}

all_trait_hmm_res <- purrr::map_df(all_traits_list, function(tr) {
  cat("Processing:", tr, "\n")
  run_hmm_wilcox_for_trait(tr)
}) %>%
  mutate(
    direction  = ifelse(log2FC > 0, group1, group2),
    Comparison = paste(group1, "-", group2)
  ) %>%
  select(Trait, HMM, Comparison, group1, group2, direction,
         mean_g1, mean_g2, log2FC, wilcox_p, wilcox_padj) %>%
  arrange(Trait, HMM, Comparison)

cat("Total rows:", nrow(all_trait_hmm_res),
    "| Significant:", sum(all_trait_hmm_res$wilcox_padj < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

write.csv(all_trait_hmm_res,
          file.path(out_dir, "ALL_trait_hmm_wilcox_GRAN3.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(
  all_trait_hmm_res %>% filter(wilcox_padj < 0.05),
  file.path(out_dir, "ALL_trait_hmm_wilcox_sig_GRAN3.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)
cat("Saved: ALL_trait_hmm_wilcox_GRAN3.csv and ALL_trait_hmm_wilcox_sig_GRAN3.csv\n")
```

##### Taxa mean relative abundance by Vegtype (phy_norm)
```{r taxa_relabun_summary}
# ── Define taxa to query ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Add/remove entries here. Each entry: list(rank = "<TaxRank>", value = "<TaxValue>")
# Valid ranks: Domain, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Species
taxa_queries <- list(
  Terriglobia   = list(rank = "Class", value = "Terriglobia"),
  Edaphobacter  = list(rank = "Genus", value = "Edaphobacter"),
  Mycobacterium = list(rank = "Genus", value = "Mycobacterium"),
  `Bog-1198`    = list(rank = "Genus", value = "Bog-1198"),
  JABFSM01 = list(rank = "Genus", value = "JABFSM01")
)

# ── Compute whole-community relative abundance once (shared denominator) ────
rel_abund_full <- transform_sample_counts(phy_norm, function(x) x / sum(x))
sdata_df       <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_norm), Sample = sample_names(phy_norm))
tax_df         <- as.data.frame(tax_table(phy_norm))

# ── Helper: per-Vegtype summary for one taxon ────────────────────────────────
summarise_taxon <- function(taxon_name, rank, value) {
  keep <- rownames(tax_df)[!is.na(tax_df[[rank]]) & tax_df[[rank]] == value]
  if (length(keep) == 0) {
    message("No OTUs found for ", taxon_name, " (", rank, " == '", value, "')")
    return(NULL)
  }
  sub_rel <- prune_taxa(keep, rel_abund_full)
  data.frame(
    Taxon     = taxon_name,
    Sample    = sample_names(sub_rel),
    rel_abund = colSums(otu_table(sub_rel))
  ) %>%
    left_join(sdata_df %>% select(Sample, Vegtype), by = "Sample") %>%
    group_by(Taxon, Vegtype) %>%
    summarise(mean_rel_abund_pct = mean(rel_abund, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
              .groups = "drop")
}

taxa_relabun_table <- purrr::imap_dfr(taxa_queries,
                                       function(q, nm) summarise_taxon(nm, q$rank, q$value)) %>%
  arrange(Taxon, Vegtype)

print(taxa_relabun_table)

write.csv(taxa_relabun_table,
          file.path(out_dir, "taxa_mean_relabun_pct.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: taxa_mean_relabun_pct.csv\n")
```

# AOA analysis

## Look at distributions
### Seeing how AOA distributes amongst samples

```{r}
# Read the data
data <- read.csv("/Users/ptasoff/My Drive/Preston_Projects/Vegtype/Analysis/Ncycle/Thaumarchaeota/Thaum_bin_coverage_table.csv")

# Scale the data
data <- data %>%
  mutate(across(17:82, ~ . * 1e9))

# Create a matrix with Genome as rownames
data_matrix <- data %>%
  select(Genome, c(17:82)) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Genome") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Extract the first and third characters of each column name
first_char <- substr(colnames(data_matrix), 1, 1)
third_char <- substr(colnames(data_matrix), 3, 3)

# Define the desired order for columns
order_first_char <- c('H', 'U', 'L')
order_third_char <- c('c', 'a', 'm', 's')

# Sort the column names based on the desired order (third character first, then first character)
sorted_indices <- order(
  match(third_char, order_third_char),
  match(first_char, order_first_char)
)

# Reorder the columns in the matrix
data_matrix <- data_matrix[, sorted_indices]

# Define the desired row order
row_order <- c(
  "L1c2_ggKbase_Nitrososphaera_41_11",
  "L1m2_metabat_bin_12",
  "U2s2_maxbin2_19",
  "U2m1_metabat_bin_14",
  "U2m2_metabat2_24",
  "L2a2_vamb_5507",
  "L2s2_abawaca1_109",
  "L2s1_metabat_bin_13",
  "L2s1_metabat2_94",
  "L2s2_maxbin2_047_sub",
  "H3m1_metabat2_84",
  "L3m1_concoct_81",
  "U2m2_vamb_3850",
  "U2s2_vamb_3544"
)

# Reorder the rows in the matrix
data_matrix <- data_matrix[row_order, ]

# Define vegetation colors
veg_colors_abv <- c(a = "#FFC125", c = "#6E8B3D", m = "#DDA0DD", s = "#CD5B45")

# Define location colors
location_colors <- c(H = "#FF6347", U = "#4682B4", L = "#32CD32")

# Create annotations based on the characters
annotations <- data.frame(
  Location = first_char[sorted_indices],
  Vegetation = third_char[sorted_indices]
)
rownames(annotations) <- colnames(data_matrix)

# Define annotation colors
ann_colors <- list(
  Vegetation = veg_colors_abv,
  Location = location_colors
)

# Plot the heatmap with annotations
pheatmap(
  data_matrix,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,
  cluster_rows = FALSE,  # Ensure rows are not clustered
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  annotation_col = annotations,
  annotation_colors = ann_colors,
  annotation_legend_side = "right",
```

```{r}
nitrosos_trait_g <- nitrosos_trait %>%
    mutate(guild = case_when(
      name %in% c("TA21_36_16", "TA21_36_9", "TA21_36_17") ~ "#FF0000",  # red
      name %in% c("Nitrosopolaris_41_11", "Nitrosopolaris_39_16") ~ "#FFA500",  # orange
      name %in% c("TH5893_38_15", "TA21_36_13", "TA21_35_17", 
                  "TH1177_29_23", "TA21_36_22") ~ "#00FF00",  # green
      name %in% c("TA21_38_10", "TA21_35_14", "Nitrosopolaris_37_15") ~ "#0000FF",  # blue
      name == "TA21_34_8" ~ "#FFC0CB",  # pink
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Default case if none of the above match
    )
  ) %>%
  select(name, Genus, guild, everything()) %>%
  arrange(guild) %>%
  mutate(name = factor(name, levels = unique(name)))


# First, let's create a function to check if a column is binary
is_binary <- function(x) {
  unique_values <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  return(length(unique_values) <= 2 && all(unique_values %in% c(0, 1)))
}

# Now, let's apply this function to our trait columns and convert non-binary columns
nitrosos_trait_binary <- nitrosos_trait_g %>%
  mutate(across(4:192, ~ if(!is_binary(.)) {
    as.numeric(. != 0)
  } else {
    .
  }))

# Check which columns were converted
converted_cols <- sapply(nitrosos_trait, is_binary) != sapply(nitrosos_trait_binary, is_binary)
cat("Converted columns:", names(converted_cols)[converted_cols], "\n")

# Remove columns where every value is zero for cleaner showing
nitrosos_trait_binary_f_mat <- nitrosos_trait_binary %>%
  arrange(factor(name, levels = genome_order)) %>%
  select(-guild, -Genus, -starts_with("Resource.Acquisition.Substrate.assimilation.C1.compounds.methanotrophy")) %>%
  select_if(~!all(. == 0)) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "name") %>%
  as.matrix() %>%
  t()

nitrosos_trait_binary_f_mat <- nitrosos_trait_binary_f_mat[, name_order]

#Generate annotation
n_annotation <- nitrosos_trait %>%
  select(name, Genus) %>%
  mutate(guild = case_when(
    name %in% c("TA21_36_16", "TA21_36_9", "TA21_36_17") ~ "#FF0000",  # red
      name %in% c("Nitrosopolaris_41_11", "Nitrosopolaris_39_16") ~ "#FFA500",  # orange
      name %in% c("TH5893_38_15", "TA21_36_13", "TA21_35_17", 
                  "TH1177_29_23", "TA21_36_22") ~ "#00FF00",  # green
      name %in% c("TA21_38_10", "TA21_35_14", "Nitrosopolaris_37_15") ~ "#0000FF",  # blue
      name == "TA21_34_8" ~ "#FFC0CB",  # pink
      TRUE ~ NA_character_  # Default case if none of the above match
  )) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "name")

# Create color palettes for the annotations
```

```{r}
  mutate(row_number = row_number()) %>%
  mutate(microtrait_hmm.description = case_when(
    row_number == 101 ~ paste0(microtrait_hmm.description, '.', suffixes['101']),
    row_number == 102 ~ paste0(microtrait_hmm.description, '.', suffixes['102']),
    row_number == 107 ~ paste0(microtrait_hmm.description, '.', suffixes['107']),
    row_number == 108 ~ paste0(microtrait_hmm.description, '.', suffixes['108']),
    row_number == 2 ~ suffixes['2'],
    row_number == 3 ~ suffixes['3'],
    row_number == 44 ~ suffixes['44'],
    row_number == 45 ~ suffixes['45'],
    TRUE ~ as.character(microtrait_hmm.description)
  )) %>%
  select(-row_number)

# Create the matrix
N_hmm_dic_mat <- N_hmm_dic %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "microtrait_hmm.description") %>%
  select(-microtrait_hmm.name, -microtrait_hmm.dbxref_kegg, everything()) %>%
  as.matrix()

# Display the first few rows of the matrix
print((N_hmm_dic_mat))


pheatmap(mat = N_hmm_dic_mat,
  show_rownames = T,
  show_colnames = T,
  cluster_rows = F,
  cluster_cols = T,
  main = "Nitrososphaerota HMM Heatmap",
  color = c("beige", "seagreen3"), # Use viridis color palette
  filename = "/Users/ptasoff/My Drive/Preston_Projects/Vegtype/Analysis/Ncycle/Figures/AOA_HMM_heatmap2.pdf", width = 15, height = 30)
```

## DO the heatmaps
### Heatmap setup
```{r}
presence_matrix <- ""
# Create the presence/absence matrix
presence_matrix <- genome2func %>%
  # Get distinct combinations of name and subfamily
  distinct(name, uniprot_function) %>%
  # Convert to presence (1) values
  mutate(present = 1) %>%
  # Spread to wide format
  pivot_wider(names_from = uniprot_function, values_from = present, values_fill = 0)

# Set row names using name column
row_data <- ""
row_data <- presence_matrix %>% column_to_rownames("name")

# Create annotation data frame for rows with the correct column names
row_annotations <- AOA_bin_info %>%
  select(name, guild, genus) %>%  # Rename 'genus' to 'Genus' to match ann_colors
  column_to_rownames("name")

# Reorder the matrix rows to match name_order
row_data <- row_data[match(name_order, rownames(row_data)),]
row_annotations <- row_annotations[match(name_order, rownames(row_annotations)),]

# Complete annotation colors list
ann_colors <- list(
  guild = c(
    "red" = "#FF0000",
    "orange" = "#FFA500",
    "green" = "#00FF00",
    "blue" = "#0000FF",
    "pink" = "hotpink"
  ),
  genus = c(
    "TA-21" = "pink",
    "Nitrosopolaris" = "purple3",
    "TH5893" = "deeppink4",

  )
)

# Option 1: Simply transpose your existing matrix
mat_t <- t(row_data)             # now rows = functions, cols = bins
col_annotation <- row_annotations  # bins moved to columns
```

### Print a Nitrification, denitrification,co2 fix cycle, and glycosyl hydrolase heatmap, faceted for those differences.
```{r}
# Define pathway-specific keywords - UPDATED to avoid overlap
nitrification_keywords <- c("ammonia", "urea", "nitrification", 
                           "hydroxylamine", "amoA", "amoB", "amoC", "nxr", "hao")
                           # Removed nirK, nirS, nitro, nitrite, nitrate

denitrification_keywords <- c("denitrification", "nitrous oxide", "nosZ", "nirK", "nirS", 
                             "norB", "norC", "nar", "nitric oxide", "napA","napB", "reduction", "nitrous-oxide reductase",
                             "nitrite reductase", "nitrite", "nitrate")
                             # Added nitrite reductase, nitrite, nitrate here

co2_fixation_keywords <- c("carbon dioxide fixation", "carboxylase", "rbcL", "rbcS", "calvin", 
                          "3-hydroxypropionate", "acetyl-CoA", "reductive citrate", 
                          "carbonic anhydrase", "RuBisCO", "ribulose", "hydroxybutyryl", "hydroxypropionate")

glycosyl_hydrolase_keywords <- c("glycosyl hydrolase", "cellulase", "amylase", "beta-glucanase", 
                                "xylanase", "chitinase", "glucosidase", "hydrolase family")

# NEW: Mixotrophy keywords
mixotrophy_keywords <- c("mixotrophic", "mixotrophy", "phagotrophy", "phagotrophic", 
                        "bacterivory", "prey consumption", "organic carbon uptake",
                        "carbohydrate active enzyme", "glycolysis", "gluconeogenesis",
                        "TCA cycle", "tricarboxylic acid", "citrate cycle",
                        "pyruvate", "phosphoenolpyruvate", "PEPCK", "PEPC",
                        "acetyl-CoA", "malate", "succinate", "fumarate",
                        "glucose transporter", "organic carbon transporter",
                        "phagocytosis", "endocytosis", "vacuole", "hexokinase",
                        "phosphofructokinase", "pyruvate kinase", "isocitrate dehydrogenase")

# Create pathway-specific matrices
mat_nitrification <- mat_t[grepl(paste(nitrification_keywords, collapse = "|"), 
                                rownames(mat_t), ignore.case = TRUE), ]
mat_denitrification <- mat_t[grepl(paste(denitrification_keywords, collapse = "|"), 
                                  rownames(mat_t), ignore.case = TRUE), ]
mat_co2_fixation <- mat_t[grepl(paste(co2_fixation_keywords, collapse = "|"), 
                               rownames(mat_t), ignore.case = TRUE), ]
mat_glycosyl <- mat_t[grepl(paste(glycosyl_hydrolase_keywords, collapse = "|"), 
                           rownames(mat_t), ignore.case = TRUE), ]
mat_mixotrophy <- mat_t[grepl(paste(mixotrophy_keywords, collapse = "|"), 
                             rownames(mat_t), ignore.case = TRUE), ]

# Remove overlaps (same as before)
overlap_genes <- intersect(rownames(mat_nitrification), rownames(mat_denitrification))
if(length(overlap_genes) > 0) {
  mat_nitrification <- mat_nitrification[!rownames(mat_nitrification) %in% overlap_genes, ]
}

# Sort rows alphabetically within each pathway
mat_nitrification <- mat_nitrification[order(rownames(mat_nitrification)), ]
mat_denitrification <- mat_denitrification[order(rownames(mat_denitrification)), ]
mat_co2_fixation <- mat_co2_fixation[order(rownames(mat_co2_fixation)), ]
mat_glycosyl <- mat_glycosyl[order(rownames(mat_glycosyl)), ]
mat_mixotrophy <- mat_mixotrophy[order(rownames(mat_mixotrophy)), ]

# Combine all pathway matrices
mat_pathways <- rbind(mat_nitrification, mat_denitrification, mat_co2_fixation, 
                      mat_glycosyl, mat_mixotrophy)

# Make row names unique
rownames(mat_pathways) <- make.names(rownames(mat_pathways), unique = TRUE)

# Create pathway annotations
pathway_annotations <- data.frame(
  pathway = c(rep("Nitrification", nrow(mat_nitrification)),

              rep("Glycosyl_Hydrolase", nrow(mat_glycosyl)),

)

# Updated annotation colors with mixotrophy
```

## Protein Folding
### Read in colabfold file and subset
```{r}
# 1. Read the CSV ----------------------------------------------------------
# Replace 'collabfold_hits.csv' with your actual file name.
hits <- read_tsv('/Users/ptasoff/My Drive/Preston_Projects/Vegtype/Analysis/Ncycle/protein_clustering/NO_quest/keyword_search.txt',
                 col_types = cols(.default = "c"))   # read everything as character first

# 2. Convert the numeric columns you care about ----------------------------
# Only ‘bits’ must be numeric for the filter; convert it (others optional)
hits <- hits %>%
  mutate(bits = as.numeric(bits))

# 3. Keep only the best hit per query --------------------------------------
# ‘Scaffold’ is the full query string; if you want to include Gene as a second
# key use both columns.  The example keeps the single highest-bits row for each
# unique Scaffold.
best_hits <- hits %>%
  group_by(Scaffold, Gene) %>%          # or group_by(Scaffold, Gene)
  filter(bits == max(bits, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# 4. Write out or continue analysing ---------------------------------------
write_csv(best_hits, "/Users/ptasoff/My Drive/Preston_Projects/Vegtype/Analysis/Ncycle/protein_clustering/NO_quest/best_collabfold_hits.csv")

hits <- read_tsv('/Users/ptasoff/My Drive/Preston_Projects/Vegtype/Analysis/Ncycle/protein_clustering/NO_quest/combined_longest_unk_subfams.fasta.rank1.fold.foldseek.tsv',
                 col_types = cols(.default = "c"))   # read everything as character first

# 2. Convert the numeric columns you care about ----------------------------
# Only ‘bits’ must be numeric for the filter; convert it (others optional)
hits <- hits %>%
  mutate(bits = as.numeric(bits))
  

# 3. Keep only the best hit per query --------------------------------------
# ‘Scaffold’ is the full query string; if you want to include Gene as a second
# key use both columns.  The example keeps the single highest-bits row for each
# unique Scaffold.
best_hits <- hits %>%
  group_by(Scaffold, Gene) %>%          # or group_by(Scaffold, Gene)
  filter(bits == max(bits, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

keywords <- c("nitric oxide", "nitrous oxide", "hcp",
              "hybrid protein cluster", "nitrogenase")

keyword_best <- best_hits %>% 
  filter(grepl(paste(keywords, collapse = "|"),
               theader,
               ignore.case = TRUE))

# 4. Write out or continue analysing ---------------------------------------
write_csv(keyword_best, "/Users/ptasoff/My Drive/Preston_Projects/Vegtype/Analysis/Ncycle/protein_clustering/NO_quest/keyword.csv")
```

```{r}
# Extract the third character of each column name
column_order <- substr(colnames(data_matrix), 3, 3)
# Define the desired order

         show_rownames = TRUE, 
         show_colnames = TRUE,

         annotation_legend_side = "right",
         main = "Nitrososphaerota Coverage by Sample",
         color = viridis::viridis(100),
         filename = "/Users/ptasoff/My Drive/Preston_Projects/Vegtype/Analysis/Ncycle/Figures/New_Names_Nitrospirota_distribution_heatmap.pdf", width = 20, height = 10)

  mutate(across(17:82, ~ . * 1e9)) %>%
  select(Genome, c(17:82))%>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "Genome")


# Transpose the abundance matrix so samples are rows
abundance_matrix <- t(as.matrix(mag_abundance))

# Calculate Bray-Curtis dissimilarity
bray_curtis_dist <- vegdist(abundance_matrix, method = "bray")

# Perform PERMANOVA
set.seed(420)
permanova_result <- adonis2(bray_curtis_dist ~ Vegtype + pH + Location + block, data = metadata, permutations = 999)

# View results
print(permanova_result)
```

```{r}
# First, let's create a function to check if a column is binary
is_binary <- function(x) {
  unique_values <- unique(x[!is.na(x)])
  return(length(unique_values) <= 2 && all(unique_values %in% c(0, 1)))
}

# Now, let's apply this function to our trait columns and convert non-binary columns
trait_binary <- trait_df %>%
  mutate(across(3:191, ~ if(!is_binary(.)) {

  } else {
    .
  }))
```

```{r}

  select(name, c(2:67)) %>%
  column_to_rownames(var = "name") %>%
  as.matrix()

# Extract the first and third characters of each column name

third_char <- substr(colnames(data_matrix), 3, 3)

# Define the desired order for columns
order_first_char <- c('H', 'U', 'L')
order_third_char <- c('c', 'a', 'm', 's')

# Sort the column names based on the desired order (third character first, then first character)
sorted_indices <- order(
  match(third_char, order_third_char),
  match(first_char, order_first_char)
)

# Reorder the columns in the matrix
data_matrix <- data_matrix[, sorted_indices]

# Define vegetation colors
veg_colors_abv <- c(a = "#FFC125", c = "#6E8B3D", m = "#DDA0DD", s = "#CD5B45")

# Define location colors
location_colors <- c(H = "#FF6347", U = "#4682B4", L = "#32CD32")

# Create annotations based on the characters
annotations <- data.frame(
  Location = first_char[sorted_indices],
  Vegetation = third_char[sorted_indices]
)
rownames(annotations) <- colnames(data_matrix)

# Define annotation colors
ann_colors <- list(
  Vegetation = veg_colors_abv,

)

index_h2m2 <- which(rownames(data_matrix) == "Palsa1315_57_9")

new_data_matrix <- rbind(
```

```{r}
# Function to process trait names
process_trait_name <- function(trait) {
  parts <- str_split(trait, "\\.")[[1]]
  if (length(parts) > 4) {
    return(paste(tail(parts, 4), collapse = "."))
  } else {
    return(trait)
  }
}

# Prepare the data
heatmap_data <- aoa_aob_only_traits %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -c(name, Phylum, Genome), names_to = "trait", values_to = "value") %>%
  group_by(Phylum, trait) %>%
  summarise(presence = as.integer(sum(value) > 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(trait = sapply(trait, process_trait_name))

# Identify traits that are present in only one phylum
unique_traits <- heatmap_data %>%
  group_by(trait) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(presence) == 2) %>%
  ungroup()

# Create the plot with + and - symbols, and add semitransparent tickmarks
symbol_plot <- ggplot(unique_traits, aes(x = Phylum, y = trait)) +
  # Add semitransparent tickmarks
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, xend = length(unique(Phylum)) + 1, 
                   y = trait, yend = trait), 
               color = "gray", alpha = 0.15, size = 0.1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(presence == 1, "+", "-"),
                color = ifelse(presence == 1, "green", "red")),
            size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_color_identity() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 6, hjust = 1),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 8),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 8)) +  # Center the subtitle
  labs(x = "Phylum", y = "Traits", 
       title = "Unique Traits Across Phyla",
       subtitle = "(+) Presence, (-) Absence") +
  
  # Extend the plot area slightly to accommodate the tickmarks
  scale_x_discrete(expand = c(0.01, 0.01))
# Print the plot
print(symbol_plot)
```

## AOA and AOB abundance
```{r}
# Filter for Steroidobacteraceae family
Nitrospirota <- subset_taxa(phy_norm, Phylum == "Nitrospirota")

# Calculate relative abundance relative to the entire community
rel_abund <- transform_sample_counts(phy_norm, function(x) x / sum(x))
rel_abund_Nitrospirota <- prune_taxa(taxa_names(Nitrospirota), rel_abund)

# Extract sample data
sample_data_df <- data.frame(sample_data(phy_norm))
sample_data_df$Sample <- rownames(sample_data_df)

# Calculate summed relative abundance and coverage
final_results <- data.frame(
  Sample = sample_names(rel_abund_Nitrospirota),
  rel_abund = colSums(otu_table(rel_abund_Nitrospirota)),
  coverage = colSums(otu_table(Nitrospirota))
)

final_results <- final_results %>%
  left_join(sample_data_df, by = "Sample") %>%
  group_by(Vegtype) %>%
  summarize(
    mean_rel_abund = mean(rel_abund),
    total_rel_abund = sum(rel_abund),
    coverage_sum = sum(coverage),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(final_results)

# Optionally, save the results to a CSV file
write.csv(final_results, "/Users/ptasoff/My Drive/Preston_Projects/Vegtype/Analysis/Figures/Abundance of Certain Taxa per vegtype/Nitrospirota_abundance_coverage.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
metadata_wgeology <- read.csv("/Users/ptasoff/My Drive/Preston_Projects/Vegtype/Analysis/R_tables/vegtype_env_metadata_wgeology.txt", header = T, sep = "\t")

metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(Name = substr(sample, 1, 3))

metadata

  left_join(metadata_wgeology, by = "Name")

write.csv(metadata_wgeology_new, file = "/Users/ptasoff/My Drive/Preston_Projects/Vegtype/Analysis/R_tables/metadata_wgeology_new.csv")

anova_ph_elevation <- aov(pH ~ Elevation, data = metadata_wgeology_new)
summary(anova_ph_geology) #Significant
summary(anova_ph_elevation) #not significant

phy_norm_f_new <- phyloseq(OTU_norm, TAX, metadata_wgeology_sample_data, rooted_tree)
```

## Permanova
```{r}
#Set seed and generate distance matrices
set.seed(420)
wunif_dist <- phyloseq::distance(phy_norm_f_new, method = "wunifrac")
unif_dist <- phyloseq::distance(phy_norm_f_new, method = "unifrac")

#unstratified permanova 
WU_adonis <- adonis2(
  wunif_dist ~ 
    sample_data(phy_norm_f_new)$Vegtype +
    sample_data(phy_norm_f_new)$pH + 
    sample_data(phy_norm_f_new)$Location + 
    sample_data(phy_norm_f_new)$depth + 
    sample_data(phy_norm_f_new)$Surface.Geology +
    sample_data(phy_norm_f_new)$Elevation +
    sample_data(phy_norm_f_new)$Aspect_NEON_10m_x3 +
    sample_data(phy_norm_f_new)$perc_moist + 
    sample_data(phy_norm_f_new)$GroundCoverPerc +
    sample_data(phy_norm_f_new)$block,
  permutations = 999
)

# Function to produce tables
table_maker <- function(adonis_res, filename_prefix) {
  
  # Extract the ANOVA table
  anova_table <- as.data.frame(adonis_res)
  
  # Create a data frame for R2 and p-values
  results_df <- anova_table %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    select(R2 = `R2`, p.value = `Pr(>F)`) %>%
    rownames_to_column(var = "Variable") %>%
    filter(Variable != "sample_data(phy_norm_f_new)$XK_ppm", Variable != "Residual", Variable != "Total")
  
  # Clean up the variable names
  results_df$Variable <- gsub("sample_data\\(phy_norm_f_new\\)\\$", "", results_df$Variable)
  results_df$Variable <- gsub("Vegtype:pH", "Vegtype * pH", results_df$Variable)
  results_df$R2 <- round(results_df$R2, digits = 2)
  
  # Display the table
  print(results_df)
  
  # Save the table as CSV
  csv_filename <- paste0(filename_prefix, ".csv")
  write.csv(results_df, file = csv_filename, row.names = FALSE)
  
  # Create a gt table
  gt_table <- gt(results_df) %>%
    tab_header(
      title = md("**Permanova Results**"),
      subtitle = filename_prefix
    )
  
  # Save the gt table as an image
  image_filename <- paste0("/Users/ptasoff/My Drive/Preston_Projects/Vegtype/Write_up/Main figures/",filename_prefix,"_fancy_table.pdf")
  gtsave(gt_table, filename = image_filename)
  
  return(results_df)
}

# Running the function for all adonis results
WU_results <- table_maker(WU_adonis, "WU_adonis")
Uni_results <- table_maker(Uni_adonis, "Uni_adonis")
WU_strat_results <- table_maker(WU_adonis_strat, "WU_adonis_strat")
Uni_strat_results <- table_maker(Uni_adonis_strat, "Uni_adonis_strat")
```
